procedural_matters: AUT 208488 was represented by Paul WENTH.
POR 211179 was represented by Miguel SILVA.
Tiago Teixeira (coach of POR 211179) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: At the zone of mark 3P, AUT 208488 and POR 211179 were sailing downwind, on port tack, with AUT 208488 clear ahead of POR 211179.
While AUT 208488 was rounding the mark, POR 211179 caught a wave and established an overlap to windward and inside of AUT 208448.
POR 211179’s mainsheet got wrapped around the neck of the competitor of AUT 208488.
AUT 208488 capsized and the competitor fell into the water.
There was no damage or injury.
conclusions: POR 211179 not overlapped with AUT 208488 and not in the zone at the time AUT 208488 reached the zone, failed to give AUT 208488 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
POR 211179 to windward failed to keep clear of AUT 208488 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
POR 211179 did not avoid contact with AUT 208488 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).

It was not reasonably possible for AUT 208488 the right-of-way boat and the boat sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled to avoid contact with POR 211179 when it became clear that POR 211179 was not keeping clear nor giving mark-room. AUT 208488 did not break RRS 14(a).
Since RRS 44.1(b) did not apply, POR 211179 took an applicable penalty by taking a Two-Turns Penalty.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since POR 211179 took an applicable penalty, she is 2025 ILCA 6 Youth European Championships & Open European Trophy not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
